comments.text: The seed is declared IN scope, listed in Artifacts ("the seed of the existing counterparty population") and described in Migration & compatibility, but nothing requires or verifies it: Requirements and Acceptance criteria are both "None", and the bean-table rules cover only the field constraints, not the one-time load. As written, a delivery that ships the entity with an empty table satisfies every stated rule. Consider a single requirement (e.g. R1: on first delivery the register is seeded with the firm's ~40 active counterparties, each with its LEI) plus one testable criterion (e.g. A1 verifies R1: after first delivery, the search screen returns the seeded counterparties, including a named spot-check). It would also help to say where the seed data comes from — a supplied file, a named owner, or hand-entry — since that determines who confirms the ~40 LEIs are correct.
